entry.headline: Extended — wait for a pullback
entry.headline_zh: 过度拉伸 — 等待回撤
entry.action: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended (momentum is fading — the daily momentum is already rolling over). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.
entry.action_zh: 已错过筑底入场——低点已经形成，目前价格已拉伸（动量正在衰竭——日线动量已开始掉头向下）。不要追高；等待回调至 10 日均线或下一个周期低点。若已持有则继续持有。
